# Seeker meat

Type: Material | Internal ID: BugMeat | Source: Seeker, ,, Seeker Soldier | Usage: Cauldron, ,, Iron cooking station, ,, Food preparation table | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Seeker meat is a food dropped by Seekers and Seeker soldiers. It can be cooked directly on an Iron cooking station, but not on a wooden Cooking station, to obtain Cooked Seeker Meat or Coal if overcooked. It is used directly in food recipes at the Food preparation table.

## Availability

• Creature: Seeker | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

• Creature: Seeker soldier | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

#### For Seeker meat

• Cooked seeker meat
• Coal, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long
• Meat platter (from Uncooked meat platter)
• Seeker aspic

#### For Cooked seeker meat

• Mushrooms galore á la Mistlands
Cooked seeker meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Seeker meat as ingredient, or vice versa.

## Notes

• For magic-oriented players, the Seeker aspic is the best Eitr-granting food available in the Mistlands.
• Because there are many Seekers in the Mistlands and the production of Meat platters tends to be bottlenecked behind the rarer Hare meat, Cooked seeker meat can serve as a good food option when the player is returning to older biomes or working on base building.

Categorias: Materials, Food
